Underwater#000.src: But recently, a small hole has opened in the shipwreck here. It is believed that our fortune is hidden within it.

Underwater#001.src: Talk to Omango located at the North of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#001.dst: 与 {p} 北边 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Omango 对话

Underwater#002.src: Hi, my name is Omango. I am a resident of the {p} village, on top of the hill.
Underwater#002.dst: 你好，我叫 Omango，是山顶上 {p} 村的居民。
Underwater#002.speaker: Omango

Underwater#003.src: As you may know, our people came to your land years ago, and this is the ship they used.
Underwater#003.dst: 你可能知道，我们的族人多年前来到你们的土地，这就是他们当时乘坐的船。
Underwater#003.speaker: Omango

Underwater#004.src: They brought lots of luxurious goods with them. Most of them got lost in the wreck.
Underwater#004.dst: 他们带来了很多奢侈品，大部分都在沉船时弄丢了。
Underwater#004.speaker: Omango

Underwater#005.src: But recently, a small hole has opened in the shipwreck here. It is believed that fortune is hidden within it.
Underwater#005.dst: 不过最近，这艘沉船上开了一个小洞。据说里面藏着财宝。
Underwater#005.speaker: Omango

Underwater#006.src: Unfortunately, nobody has been able to explore it. It is too deep, no creature can survive underwater that long!
Underwater#006.dst: 可惜一直没人能进去探索。太深了，没有生物能在水下待那么久！
Underwater#006.speaker: Omango

Underwater#007.src: However, my old friend Sayrr is a fisherman, and I know that he has a very special helmet...
Underwater#007.dst: 不过，我的老朋友 Sayrr 是个渔夫，我知道他有一顶非常特别的头盔……
Underwater#007.speaker: Omango

Underwater#008.src: If you convince him to give you this helmet, and find the treasure, I'll give you a part of it!
Underwater#008.dst: 如果你能说服他把头盔给你，再找到宝藏，我就分你一份！
Underwater#008.speaker: Omango

Underwater#009.src: Sayrr is out on his boat, but the cave next to me is a quick way over to where he does his fishing. Be careful on the way, though.
Underwater#009.dst: Sayrr 正在他的船上，不过我旁边这个洞窟是去他钓鱼的地方的捷径。路上小心点。
Underwater#009.speaker: Omango

Underwater#010.src: When you finally have the helmet, explore the ship and bring me back [{~} Ancient Treasure]. Good luck.
Underwater#010.dst: 拿到头盔之后，就去探索那艘船，把 [{~} 古代宝藏] 带回来给我。祝你好运。
Underwater#010.speaker: Omango

Underwater#011.src: Go through the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find Sayrr on his boat on the other side
Underwater#011.dst: 穿过 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的洞窟，在另一边的船上找到 Sayrr

Underwater#012.src: Why ya looking at me like that? Is it cause I'm small, eh? I'll have you know that I caught fish that were twice your size!
Underwater#012.dst: 干嘛那样看我？是因为我个子小，嗯？告诉你，我钓过比你大两倍的鱼！
Underwater#012.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#013.src: ...or, well, I used to be able to. Nothing's biting recently- wait a sec, why'd you hop on my boat anyways, stranger?
Underwater#013.dst: ……呃，至少以前钓得到。最近一条都不上钩——等一下，陌生人，你到底跳上我的船干嘛？
Underwater#013.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#014.src: Ahah! Yes, I still have that old breathing helmet. You want it? You'll have to do something for me first.
Underwater#014.dst: 啊哈！对，那顶旧的呼吸头盔我还留着。你想要？那你得先帮我做件事。
Underwater#014.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#015.src: I'm sure you heard me, but the fish just aren't biting around here anymore! I need to make a living somehow! There's some fish in that cave, but...
Underwater#015.dst: 你应该听到了，这一带的鱼就是不上钩了！我总得想办法过日子啊！那个洞窟里倒是有些鱼，不过……
Underwater#015.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#016.src: ...it's a bit dangerous. Tell ya what, I'll give you my fishing rod, and you can go catch me, say, [{~} Gudgeon Meat] down there.
Underwater#016.dst: ……有点危险。这样吧，我把钓竿给你，你去下面帮我钓个，比如说，[{~} 小河鱼肉]。
Underwater#016.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#017.src: The helmet will be all yours after that.
Underwater#017.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#018.src: Bring back [{~} Gudgeon Meat] found in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to Sayrr
Underwater#018.dst: 把在 [-{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 洞窟里找到的 [{~1} 小河鱼肉] 带回给 Sayrr

Underwater#019.src: Ah! Welcome back! Any luck with the fish?
Underwater#019.dst: 啊！欢迎回来！钓到鱼了吗？
Underwater#019.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#020.src: Great, and I'll thank you kindly. Here's your helmet, have fun with that.
Underwater#020.dst: 太好了，真是谢谢你。这是你的头盔，玩得开心。
Underwater#020.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#021.src: Explore the crashed ship for a lost treasure at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#021.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的沉船里寻找失落的宝藏

Underwater#022.src: Break the crate and bring [{~} Old Treasure] to Omango at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#022.dst: 打破箱子，把 [{~} 旧宝藏] 带给 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Omango

Underwater#023.src: You got it! You found the treasure!
Underwater#023.dst: 你拿到了！你找到宝藏了！
Underwater#023.speaker: Omango

Underwater#024.src: As promised, here's your part of the loot.
Underwater#024.dst: 说好的，这是你那份战利品。
Underwater#024.speaker: Omango
